meta.docSubtitle: 12 confirmed flows · HD Portal + Salesforce + ComputerEase + DocHub + GCP + Deltek · Most answers are pre-filled — please verify and correct
meta.source: Scoping calls with Peerless Fence team — contact: Ashley (operations lead)

bizContext.snapshot: Right now, your team is manually moving data between six systems every single day. Ashley enters leads from HD Portal into Salesforce, then manually creates customer records in ComputerEase, then uploads contracts, then enters deposit amounts—each step a chance for error and delay. You've told us: 'I don't like your view. It looks terrible... If you go to and then change it to classic instead of workflow. Then that way it makes it easier to see. I don't like the other one. The other one I have to click on a couple of different things just to get around.' The friction is real, and it's costing you time. On go-live Monday, those manual handoffs stop. Leads flow automatically from HD Portal to Salesforce every 10 minutes. When a sales rep closes an opportunity, the job data moves directly to ComputerEase with budget details intact. Contracts sync from DocHub to ComputerEase without re-entry. Most answers in this form are already filled in from your scoping calls.

journeyCards.label: Phase 1 — Connected
journeyCards.headline: HD Portal, Salesforce, ComputerEase, and DocHub become a single data path
journeyCards.body: Things that stop on go-live Monday: UC1 (manual lead review before Salesforce entry) · UC3 (Ashley manually creating customer records in ComputerEase) · UC5 (manual quote verification and entry) · UC6 (manual attachment of ComputerEase work orders to Salesforce) · UC7 (manual contract document upload) · UC12 (manual deposit entry). Lead sync runs every 10 minutes. Job entry flows from Salesforce to ComputerEase with budget data. Contracts move from DocHub to ComputerEase automatically.

journeyCards.label: Phase 2 — Automated
journeyCards.headline: Deposit verification and quote line item validation trigger job creation without human dispatch
journeyCards.body: PF1: Automated deposit verification from HD Portal triggers job entry in ComputerEase without Ashley's manual backend check. PF2: Quote line items from Salesforce validate against product master data (material type, picket type, post caps, gates) and flag discrepancies before job entry. PF3: Intelligent document processing extracts contract data from 299A, 299B, 118 documents, validates against business rules (permit date, deposit matching, signature legibility), and flags exceptions for review.

journeyCards.label: Phase 3 — Agentic
journeyCards.headline: AI reads the Salesforce data foundation Phase 1 built
journeyCards.body: Salesforce AgentForce gains access to the unified lead, opportunity, quote, and job objects Phase 1 established. AI can recommend next actions (follow-up calls, contract generation, material ordering) based on real-time job status from ComputerEase, contract compliance from DocHub, and customer history—all flowing through a single source of truth.

p0Blockers.title: Enable ComputerEase API Access
p0Blockers.clientAction: — Contact Deltek support and submit a vendor support ticket to enable API access for ComputerEase. Request configuration of the CE Live Service relay and confirm API version compatibility (v26+). Verify that sandbox and production environments have feature parity so we can test safely before going live.

p0Blockers.title: Harden GCP Firewall Rules for ComputerEase VM
p0Blockers.clientAction: — Work with your IT team or GCP administrator immediately. The current firewall rules allow SSH and RDP access from anywhere, which is a critical security vulnerability. Restrict SSH/RDP access to only authorized IP addresses and configure network isolation for the ComputerEase VM before any integration work begins.

p0Blockers.title: Verify Salesforce API User Permissions and Admin Access
p0Blockers.clientAction: — Confirm that the designated Salesforce API user has the necessary permissions for integration and that a Salesforce administrator has full access to configure API integrations. Establish a read-only API user for ComputerEase data sync to prevent unintended modifications to your Salesforce data.

p0Blockers.title: Obtain Home Depot Service Center Portal API Credentials
p0Blockers.clientAction: — Contact the Home Depot Portal team (Marius) to obtain API credentials for the lead generation API. Discuss webhook or polling mechanisms for real-time lead updates and confirm the 10-minute sync frequency is achievable on their end.

p0Blockers.title: Configure DocHub for Digital Signature Capture and API Access
p0Blockers.clientAction: — Configure DocHub to capture digital signatures for contract types 299A, 299B, and 118. Establish a document storage and retrieval API so signed contracts can flow automatically into Salesforce and ComputerEase without manual upload.

sections.title: Use Cases & Integration Flows
sections.bodyHtml:
UC7

Contract Document Upload to ComputerEase (event-triggered)

▼

HD Portal (Home Depot Service Center) → ComputerEase · Contract (299A, 299B, 118) · Triggered when signed contract documents are available in HD Portal

1

⚠️ CRITICAL: Does the HD Portal expose a document download API (or SFTP/webhook) for retrieving signed contract files (299A, 299B, 118), or must documents be downloaded manually from the portal UI?

2

In ComputerEase, which job record field or attachment section receives the uploaded contract documents, and is there a maximum file size or accepted format restriction (e.g., PDF only)?

3

Confirm three items about the document upload flow: (a) Which team member (Ashley or another role) is responsible for triggering or approving the upload? (b) Should all three document types (299A, 299B, 118) be uploaded together as a batch, or individually as each becomes available? (c) Is a confirmation notification required after successful upload?

→ See Section 3.7 for the pre-filled UC7 field mapping table.

In ScopeDataSkate will build an automated flow to retrieve signed contract documents (299A, 299B, 118) from HD Portal (via API or SFTP once credentials are confirmed) and attach them to the corresponding ComputerEase job record using the CE Live Service API.
Assumes Pre-existsHD Portal API credentials obtained from Marius (HD Portal team); ComputerEase API access enabled and CE Live Service relay configured by Deltek support (v26+); GCP firewall rules hardened to allow inbound API traffic to ComputerEase VM.
Out of ScopeDataSkate will NOT modify or reformat contract document content, perform OCR or data extraction from PDFs, manage document versioning within ComputerEase, or configure HD Portal document storage settings.
UC8

Task Creation for Material and Labor (event-triggered)

▼

Salesforce → ComputerEase · Task · Triggered when a new project is created in Salesforce requiring material purchases and labor assignments

4

⚠️ CRITICAL: What Salesforce object or record event triggers task creation — is it a specific Opportunity stage change, a Project record creation, or a manual action by Ashley?

5

What task fields are required in both Salesforce and ComputerEase — for example, task type (material vs. labor), assigned team member, due date, cost code, and linked job number?

→ See Section 3.8 for the pre-filled UC8 field mapping table.

In ScopeDataSkate will build an automated flow that listens for the confirmed Salesforce trigger event, creates corresponding task records in ComputerEase (material and labor), and maps team member assignments and job linkage fields.
Assumes Pre-existsSalesforce API user permissions verified and admin access confirmed; ComputerEase API access enabled with CE Live Service relay configured; task types and cost codes pre-configured in ComputerEase before go-live.
Out of ScopeDataSkate will NOT manage team member scheduling, configure cost codes in ComputerEase, sync task status updates back from ComputerEase to Salesforce (bidirectional sync), or build Salesforce UI changes.
UC9

Appointment Scheduling Sync (event-triggered)

▼

HD Portal (Home Depot Service Center) → Salesforce · Appointment · Triggered when a sales rep schedules a consultation appointment in HD Portal

6

Does the HD Portal emit a webhook or provide a polling endpoint when an appointment is created or updated, and what appointment fields are available (e.g., customer name, address, date/time, assigned rep, appointment type)?

7

In Salesforce, should the appointment sync to a standard Event record on the calendar, a custom object, or an existing Activity record linked to the Lead or Opportunity?

→ See Section 3.9 for the pre-filled UC9 field mapping table.

In ScopeDataSkate will build a flow to receive appointment data from HD Portal (via webhook or 10-minute polling) and create or update a corresponding Salesforce Event record linked to the relevant Lead or Opportunity.
Assumes Pre-existsHD Portal API credentials obtained from Marius; lead generation API configured for 10-minute sync frequency; Salesforce API user permissions verified with admin access confirmed; Lead/Opportunity records already exist in Salesforce at time of appointment sync.
Out of ScopeDataSkate will NOT sync appointment cancellations or reschedules unless explicitly added to scope, configure Salesforce calendar views or notification rules, or manage rep assignment logic within Salesforce.
UC10

GCP Infrastructure Configuration (event-triggered)

▼

Google Cloud Platform (GCP) → ComputerEase · Infrastructure · Triggered during initial integration setup to enable/restrict API access to the ComputerEase VM

8

⚠️ CRITICAL: Confirm three infrastructure items: (a) Who is the GCP administrator responsible for applying firewall rule changes? (b) What is the static IP or IP range that should be whitelisted for MuleSoft/DataSkate API calls to the ComputerEase VM? (c) Is there an existing VPN or private network path between GCP and any external systems, or is all access over public internet?

→ See Section 3.10 for the pre-filled UC10 infrastructure configuration reference table.

In ScopeDataSkate will provide required MuleSoft CloudHub IP ranges for whitelisting, validate API connectivity to the ComputerEase VM post-hardening, and document the network configuration requirements for the GCP administrator.
Assumes Pre-existsClient has an identified GCP administrator or IT resource capable of modifying firewall rules; ComputerEase VM is running and accessible on GCP; Deltek support ticket for CE Live Service relay is in progress.
Out of ScopeDataSkate will NOT directly modify GCP firewall rules, manage GCP IAM policies, configure VPN tunnels, or administer the ComputerEase VM operating system or server configuration.
UC11

API Configuration via Deltek Support (event-triggered)

▼

Deltek Support Portal → ComputerEase · API Configuration · Triggered when a support ticket is submitted to enable API access and configure CE Live Service relay

9

⚠️ CRITICAL: Has a Deltek support ticket been submitted to enable the ComputerEase API and configure the CE Live Service relay? If so, what is the ticket number and expected resolution date? If not, who on the client side will own this action item?

→ See Section 3.11 for the pre-filled UC11 API configuration reference table.

In ScopeDataSkate will provide technical requirements documentation for the Deltek support ticket, validate CE Live Service relay connectivity once enabled, and confirm API version compatibility (v26+) during integration testing.
Assumes Pre-existsClient has an active Deltek support contract; ComputerEase is installed and running on the GCP VM; GCP firewall rules are hardened to allow CE Live Service relay traffic before API testing begins.
Out of ScopeDataSkate will NOT submit the Deltek support ticket on the client's behalf, negotiate Deltek licensing terms, upgrade the ComputerEase application version, or administer the Deltek support portal account.
UC12

Deposit and Payment Terms Entry (event-triggered)

▼

HD Portal (Home Depot Service Center) → ComputerEase · Deposit · Triggered when a deposit amount and payment terms are confirmed in the HD Portal contract

10

Confirm three items about deposit and payment terms data: (a) Where exactly does the deposit amount appear in HD Portal — is it a structured data field in the API response, or embedded in the contract PDF? (b) What are the standard payment term options (e.g., 50% deposit / 50% on completion)? (c) Which specific fields in the ComputerEase job record receive the deposit amount and payment terms?

→ See Section 3.12 for the pre-filled UC12 field mapping table.

In ScopeDataSkate will build a flow to extract deposit amount and payment terms from the HD Portal API response and write these values to the corresponding ComputerEase job record billing fields via the CE Live Service API.
Assumes Pre-existsHD Portal API credentials obtained from Marius with deposit and payment terms available as structured data fields; ComputerEase API access enabled with CE Live Service relay configured; GCP firewall rules hardened for API access.
Out of ScopeDataSkate will NOT process payment transactions, integrate with payment gateways, extract deposit data from unstructured PDF documents (covered under PF3 if scoped), or configure billing workflows within ComputerEase.

Potential Flows — Not Priced in This Proposal

The flows below were identified during discovery as automation opportunities but are outside the current confirmed scope. Review each and check the box if you would like DataSkate to include it in a revised proposal.

IDFlow + RationalePriorityScope Decision
PF1 Automated Deposit Verification and Job Trigger
HD Portal → ComputerEase · Deposit

Ashley currently manually checks HD Portal backend reporting to find deposits and update Salesforce. An automated API flow could verify deposit status and trigger job entry without manual intervention, reducing data entry errors and accelerating job processing.		 Evaluate Add to scope
PF2 Quote Line Item Validation and Product Matching
Salesforce → ComputerEase · Quote Line Item

Quote line items in Salesforce contain product bundle data (material type, picket type, post caps, gates) that must be validated against contract specifications. An automated flow could extract quote line items, validate against master data, and flag discrepancies before job entry.		 Evaluate Add to scope
PF3 Intelligent Document Processing for Contract Validation
HD Portal → Salesforce · Contract (299A, 299B, 118)

Contract documents are currently manually reviewed by Ashley for compliance. An IDP flow could automatically extract contract data, validate against business rules (permit date, deposit amount matching, signature legibility), and flag exceptions for manual review.		 Evaluate Add to scope

External ID fields prevent duplicate record creation during upsert operations. Each integration flow uses a unique key from the source system to match or create records in the target. Confirm that each Salesforce External ID field exists and is marked as unique on the object.

sections.title: Volume and Performance

sections.bodyHtml:
Section 6 — Error Handling

This section defines how DataSkate will handle failures, retries, data loss prevention, and recovery across all confirmed flows. Error handling strategy is differentiated by flow criticality and data sensitivity.

6.1 — Retry and Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) Strategy

32

When a target system is unavailable or rejects a message, what is the retry and failure escalation strategy?

6.2 — Message Expiry and Queue Retention

33

How long should messages remain in the retry queue before expiring? (Differentiate by flow type if needed.)

6.3 — Failure Notification and Escalation

34

Who should be notified when a flow fails, and via what channel (email, Slack, SMS)?

6.4 — Data Loss Prevention Strategy

35

Confirm data loss tolerance by flow type: which flows require zero data loss vs. best-effort delivery?

6.5 — Idempotency and Duplicate Prevention

36

Must all flows be idempotent (safe to replay without creating duplicates)?

6.6 — Rollback and Partial Failure Handling

37

For multi-step flows (e.g., job header + customer + worksheet in UC2), is full rollback required if one step fails, or is partial retry acceptable?

Summary: All flows use exponential backoff retry → DLQ. Financial flows (job, customer, contract, deposit) enforce zero data-loss with idempotent upserts. Lead sync and appointment scheduling use best-effort with automatic re-poll. Failures escalate to Ashley and DataSkate on-call within 2 hours.

internalFlags.bodyHtml:
INTERNAL TECHNICAL FLAGS — DO NOT SEND TO CLIENT

  1. ComputerEase API Access Blocker (P0): Deltek support ticket required to enable API access and configure CE Live Service relay. API version must be v26+. Sandbox/production parity must be verified before development begins. This is a hard dependency for all ComputerEase integrations (UC2, UC3, UC6, UC7, UC8, UC12).
  2. GCP Firewall Security Vulnerability (P0): Current rules allow SSH/RDP from anywhere. Must be hardened to restrict access to authorized IPs only and configure network isolation for ComputerEase VM. Security sign-off required before any production deployment.
  3. Salesforce API User Permissions (P0): Designated API user must have appropriate permissions; admin must have full access to configure integrations. Sandbox environment parity with production must be confirmed. Read-only API user recommended for ComputerEase data sync to prevent unintended modifications.
  4. Home Depot Portal API Credentials (P0): Credentials from Marius (HD Portal team) are required for lead generation API. Webhook or polling mechanism for real-time lead updates must be established. 10-minute sync frequency for UC1 depends on this.
  5. DocHub Digital Signature Configuration (P0): DocHub must be configured to capture digital signatures for contract types 299A, 299B, 118. Document storage and retrieval API must be established for Salesforce integration (UC4, UC7).
  6. ComputerEase Legacy Modernization Assessment (P1): ComputerEase is a legacy application. Technical debt and modernization potential must be assessed early. This affects long-term maintainability of UC2, UC3, UC6, UC8, UC12.
  7. Salesforce Sandbox Testing Strategy (P1): Sandbox environment has limitations. Robust testing strategy required for production-only features. UC1, UC2, UC4, UC5, UC6, UC8 all require sandbox validation before production cutover.
  8. Real-Time Lead Sync Feasibility (P1): UC1 requires 10-minute polling from HD Portal to Salesforce. Evaluate whether real-time synchronization is technically feasible given HD Portal API constraints and Salesforce rate limits.
  9. IDP Integration for Contract Validation (P1): Explore Intelligent Document Processing for automated extraction and validation of contract data (299A, 299B, 118). This could reduce manual review burden in UC4 and UC7 but requires scope clarification.
  10. Quote Line Item Business Rules (P1): Define clear business rules and conditional logic for data extraction and mapping of quote line items (material type, picket type, post caps, gates). UC5 and PF2 depend on this clarity.
  11. Process Automation Prioritization (P1): Scope process automation for manual tasks (UC3, UC5, UC6, UC7, UC8, UC12). Prioritize high-impact, frequently executed tasks. Ashley is currently a SPOF for multiple manual workflows.
  12. User Provisioning and Permission Models (P2): Verify user provisioning and permission models across all integrated systems (Salesforce, ComputerEase, DocHub, HD Portal, GCP). Ensure proper access control and audit trails for compliance.
  13. Multi-Environment Deployment Strategy (P2): Document deployment strategy for sandbox, staging, and production. Read-only access in sandboxes; controlled write access in production. GCP infrastructure must support this separation.
